author: Axiom I
title: Adaptive Buffered Ring v1.1: Lossy integration (r=0.9/0.85)
abstract: Extends adaptive buffered ring with lossy links. Uses suggest-bridge obs (Δcoverage, processed/step, drop_rate, queue_load) and targets. Compares immediate vs delayed service for reliabilities 0.9 and 0.85 with 15 replicates.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, time, statistics as stats
from pathlib import Path

START = time.time()
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from utilities.seed_tools import set_seed, make_rng, seed_from_str, mix_seed
from coord.adaptive_buffered_ring import run_adaptive_buffered

base_seed = seed_from_str("Axiom-adaptive-buffered-ring-v1.1-lossy")
set_seed(base_seed)
_, _ = make_rng(base_seed)

cfg = {
    "N": 24,
    "max_steps": 500,
    "buffer_size": 8,
    "service_rate": 2,
    "serve_after_opts": [False, True],
    "reliabilities": [0.9, 0.85],
    "bidirectional": True,
    "p0": 0.6,
    "sampler_cfg": {"initial_rate": 0.6, "adjustment_factor": 1.2},
    "targets": {
        "p_min": 0.6, "p_max": 1.0,
        "target_delta": 0.12,
        "target_dps": 12,
        "target_drop": 0.02,
        "target_queue_load": 0.5,
        "k_cov": 0.8, "k_dps": 0.05, "k_drop": 0.5, "k_q": 0.3
    },
    "replicates": 15
}

def run_case(r, sa, rep):
    seed = mix_seed(base_seed, int(r * 1000) + (100 if sa else 200) + rep)
    return run_adaptive_buffered(
        N=cfg["N"], max_steps=cfg["max_steps"], base_seed=seed,
        buffer_size=cfg["buffer_size"], service_rate=cfg["service_rate"], serve_after=sa,
        reliability=r, bidirectional=cfg["bidirectional"],
        p0=cfg["p0"], sampler_cfg=cfg["sampler_cfg"], targets=cfg["targets"], track_history=True
    )

results = {str(r): {"False": [], "True": []} for r in cfg["reliabilities"]}
for r in cfg["reliabilities"]:
    for sa in cfg["serve_after_opts"]:
        for rep in range(cfg["replicates"]):
            results[str(r)][str(sa)].append(run_case(r, sa, rep))

def summarize(items):
    def mean(xs): return float(stats.fmean(xs)) if xs else None
    t_full = [x["steps_to_full"] for x in items if x["steps_to_full"] is not None]
    drops_ps = [x["dropped"] / max(1, x["steps"]) for x in items]
    proc_ps = [x["processed"] / max(1, x["steps"]) for x in items]
    modes = sorted(list({x["controller"]["type"] for x in items}))
    return {
        "time_to_full_mean": mean(t_full),
        "drops_per_step_mean": mean(drops_ps),
        "processed_per_step_mean": mean(proc_ps),
        "controller_modes": modes,
    }

out_dir = Path("storage/shared/coord/results")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path = out_dir / "axiom_adaptive_buffered_ring_v1_1_lossy.json"

report = {
    "config": cfg,
    "summaries": {
        r: {sa: summarize(results[r][sa]) for sa in ["False", "True"]} for r in results
    }
}

with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

END = time.time()
print("=== Adaptive Buffered Ring v1.1 (Lossy) ===")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": str(out_path), **report}, indent=2))
print("Adaptive buffered ring v1.1 lossy complete.")
